title: 1.5 Million Wildebeest Cross a River Full of Crocodiles

scenes.text: More than a million wildebeest cross a river full of crocodiles.
It's the Great Migration, a loop through the Serengeti and the Maasai Mara.
More than one and a half million wildebeest take part.
The Mara River is the biggest obstacle. Crocodiles wait, and many animals get crushed in the rush.
More than two hundred fifty thousand animals die on the journey every year.

description:
More than 1.5 million wildebeest follow the Great Migration through Tanzania and Kenya, crossing the crocodile-filled Mara River.
An estimated 250,000 animals die during the migration each year.
Would you cross?
first_comment: Bonus: a quarter of a million animals die on this trip every year. Would you rather face the crocodiles or the lions?
